plan.notes: Official Cal Poly 2026-2028 Catalog (semester system; Cal Poly converted from quarters to semesters in Fall 2026), Journalism BS program PDF, 'Concentration Not Yet Declared' suggested four-year flowchart. The flowchart states it is a planning guide, not a required sequence. Term totals as printed: 13 / 15 / 15 / 16 / 15 / 15 / 16 / 15 = 120, matching the printed 'Total Units 120'. Course titles verified against the program's 2026-2028 Degree Requirements section (JOUR 1102 Introduction to Journalism; JOUR 2203 News Reporting and Writing; JOUR 2228 Media, Self and Society; JOUR 2285 Introduction to Multimedia Journalism; JOUR 3300 Public Relations; JOUR 3303 Video Storytelling; JOUR 3302 Mass Media Law; JOUR 3305 Journalism Ethics; JOUR 3334 Editing for Online and Print Publication; JOUR 3390 Visual Communication for the Mass Media; JOUR 4444 Media Internship; JOUR 2219 Mass Media in a Cross-Cultural Society; JOUR 3319 Global Communication; STAT 1000 Statistical and Data Literacy; STAT 1110 Applied Statistical Concepts and Methods; STAT 1210 Business Statistics I). GE 2026 pattern: 43 units, 6 specified in Major/Support; area codes in the plan (1A Written Communication, 1B Critical Thinking, 1C Oral Communication, 4B Social and Behavioral Sciences). 'Concentration Course or Elective' slots per the plan (concentrations: News, Public Relations, Media Innovation, Individualized Course of Study). 'Journalism Elective' slots: any JOUR courses. Prerequisites not listed on the flowchart; see official course descriptions in the 2026-2028 catalog.
